global: This miso ramen boasts a rich, golden broth cradling tender chashu, crisp menma, and a delicate naruto fish cake, all beneath a single nori sheet. Served in a blue-patterned bowl, it gleams under warm light on a wooden table, with a small side dish nearby.

regions.background: Light wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and warm tone, smooth and slightly reflective.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a blue and white patterned rim with intricate floral designs and a smooth, glossy finish.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, golden-yellow, glossy, swirling, speckled with green onions and black pepper.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark, glossy, rectangular, with a slightly uneven, crinkled surface and visible texture.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a thick, round slice with pinkish-white meat, browned edges, and speckled with black pepper.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with fibrous texture and irregular, tapered shapes.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: round, pale yellow with pink swirl, textured surface, slightly toasted edges.
